vectors.name: request_write

vectors.name: request_negative_arg
vectors.meaning: openat(AT_FDCWD=-100, 0x2000, 0, 0): sys=257 | arg1=-100 as two's-complement int64 | arg2=0x2000 | arg3..arg6=0

vectors.name: request_memory_write
vectors.meaning: memory write into the server process: recvfrom(server_fd=14, dest=0x7f0000003000, len=44, MSG_WAITALL=0x100, 0, 0); the 44 raw bytes follow this request on the same stream and the response is 44

vectors.name: request_memory_read
vectors.meaning: memory read from the server process: sendto(server_fd=14, src=0x7f0000003000, len=44, flags=0, 0, 0); the server-to-client stream then carries the 44 bytes followed by the response 44

vectors.name: response_ok
vectors.meaning: response for a syscall that returned 12: the raw kernel return value as int64

vectors.name: response_enoent
vectors.hex: fe ff ff ff ff ff ff ff
vectors.meaning: response for a syscall that failed with ENOENT: -2 as two's-complement int64; the client raises OSError(2)

vectors.name: trampoline_stack
vectors.meaning: struct rsyscall_trampoline_stack for Trampoline(function=0x7f0000001000, args=[7, 7]) as used for rsyscall_server(sock, sock): rdi=7 | rsi=7 | rdx,rcx,r8,r9=0 | function

vectors.name: stack_image
vectors.meaning: the 64-byte stack image passed to clone as child_stack: address of rsyscall_trampoline (0x7f0000002000) | rdi | rsi | rdx..r9 | target function; rsp points at byte 0 when the child starts

vectors.name: futex_node
vectors.meaning: FutexNode(next=None, futex=1) as written before clone: next=NULL | futex=1 (uint32) | 4 bytes of tail padding (zero)

vectors.name: clone_args

optional_flags: CLONE_PARENT when the cloning task is not the monitoring task
any CLONE_* the caller passes, e.g. CLONE_FILES
normal_child.child_stack: address of the 64-byte stack image (16-byte aligned)
normal_child.ctid: address of the FutexNode + 8 (offsetof(struct futex_node, futex))

futex_helper.child_stack: address of its own 64-byte stack image

vectors.meaning: arguments of the raw clone syscall issued by the client, in argument order (flags, child_stack, ptid, ctid, newtls)
vectors.generator: constants of linux/sched.h on x86-64 (cross-checked with rsyscall._raw.lib in venv mode)

vectors.name: persistent_count
vectors.meaning: Int32(2): the native int32 count of passed fds that opens the persistent reconnection handshake

vectors.name: persistent_reply
vectors.meaning: the server's reply to a count of 2: exactly two native int32 fd numbers in the order the fds were passed; decodes to [5, 6] (fd[0] becomes the server's new infd/outfd)

vectors.name: scm_rights_4fds
